issues.description: Module-import-time monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates a third-party SDK's private global
issues.detail: Setting genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 5MB at import is a process-wide side effect on a private underscore attribute. Any consumer importing pipecat.services.google.llm silently re-tunes the shared SDK, and the patch will vanish or crash on SDK rename. Configure via the public HttpOptions/client surface at construction time, or upstream a fix.

issues.description: image.tobytes() emitted with format='RGB' without convert('RGB') corrupts non-RGB PIL images
issues.detail: PIL decodes images in their native mode (RGBA, P, L are common for generated PNGs). Calling tobytes() while labeling the frame format='RGB' produces wrong byte counts and garbled pixels downstream. Explicitly call image = image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(), or propagate image.mode as the declared format.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior shift bundled into a feature PR
issues.detail: Flipping the default changes latency, cost, and output semantics for every caller relying on the default. It is coupled to an unrelated image-generation feature, making it hard to revert or reason about independently. Ship the default bump as its own change with a deprecation note.

issues.description: Model-capability dispatch via substring checks on the model name is fragile
issues.detail: Both 'image' in self._model_name and startswith('gemini-2.5-flash') encode capability facts as string shape. Future model names will silently regress (e.g., 'gemini-3-vision'). Replace with a small capability table or named predicate (is_image_generation_model) keyed by model id so the rule is explicit and testable.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService extends the service's output contract without documentation
issues.detail: GoogleLLMService's documented postcondition is text and tool-call streaming. Pushing OutputImageRawFrame mid-stream strengthens what downstream pipelines must accept. Document which models produce image frames, the ordering guarantees relative to LLMTextFrame, and add a guard plus mime_type check so non-image inline_data does not crash the loop.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus on two P0 issues that should block merge: a module-import-time monkey-patch of a private google-genai global (READ_BUFFER_SIZE), and an image emission path that labels PIL bytes as RGB without converting modes — both fail silently and were flagged unanimously. Secondary consensus: the default-model bump is a silent behavior shift smuggled into a feature PR and should be separated, and capability detection by substring matching on model names should become a small data-driven predicate. The image-emission branch also extends the LLM service contract without documenting it or guarding against non-image inline_data. Fix the patch via a public SDK surface, convert images explicitly, separate the default change, and name the image-model capability.
